utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday, 25 November. Are we all on? I've got seven tiles, but one of them might just be frozen.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, morning. Can you hear me with this headset? Sounds like I'm stood inside a bucket.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: We can hear you. Unfortunately, the headset hasn't changed that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Charming. Whose new car's that in the car park, then? Grey one, taking up about a space and a half.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more primer than paint.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grey one probably costs more than my house. Anyway, morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto vehicle valuations, what's already finished? Keep that separate from the actions.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the site water yesterday. That's done, not something we're carrying into today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That was the one we had on yesterday's list, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's it. Same one. Closed off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I tested the line one HPU yesterday and it's all fine now. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Good. No outstanding controls bit on that, then. I'm not adding anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One observation: I heard a slight rattle from the line three. Nothing to action yet, just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so that's not a maintenance job coming out of this?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, just an observation at this point. No new action.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the big board. Still blocked, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So there's still no confirmed delivery slot. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Nothing new to promise this morning. That isn't a fresh chasing job, just the blocker as it stands.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Separately, I'll go to the overflow store to pick up the replacement parts for the GT2 inlet valve first thing tomorrow. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, separate from the big board delivery. Don't want those two getting muddled together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. Mine's the pickup from the overflow store, not waiting on that supplier confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Got you, Sarah. First thing tomorrow for the GT2 inlet valve parts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Doyler, can you do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances this morning? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances this morning. Top priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—pre-use checks, rather than anything wider on them?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's right, the pre-use checks. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the arm on two by 11am. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The guarding specifically, yeah? Not a general mechanical inspection of the whole arm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, specifically the guarding on the arm on two. Keeping it to that, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, Sarah. Normal priority for that check, understood.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Speaking of keeping things contained, anyone actually risking outdoor plans this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Have you seen the forecast? Sideways rain. Very scenic.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: We'd said we'd go for a walk. Think the weather's going to turn that into sitting in a café, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Solid British weekend. Right, back to it—two separate things here, don't bundle them together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you update the risk assessment for work on the water booster by Wednesday? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, by Wednesday as in today, just so we're not reading that as next week?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today, Wednesday. It matters but it's not urgent; it doesn't jump ahead of the top-priority stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the water booster by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the paperwork for the work, not an instruction to start work on the water booster itself?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Risk assessment update only. I'm not taking on a separate booster job here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Then, Tomasz, can you book a contractor to look at the front end of one by the end of the week? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. The booking by the end of the week, rather than saying they'll definitely have been on site by then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Book a contractor to look at it. We're not promising their attendance by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, I'll book a contractor to look at the front end of one by the end of the week. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—got it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, so we're not turning that into an in-house strip-down as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Just the contractor booking. Let's not grow legs on it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Before I forget, there's a birthday cake in the office. That's information, not another item for your list.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Depends what sort of cake. Might be the most important information we've had.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Chocolate. Already cut, too, so nobody needs an engineering drawing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Still get someone arguing about the tolerances on the slices.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Without a doubt. Anything else that actually needs to be agreed?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, one from me. I'll write up the near miss at the long belt at half two. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona Doyle. At half two, specifically—not just sometime this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly, at half two. I'll drop everything for that one and do the write-up then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. The write-up of the near miss we've already discussed, not a second incident?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same near miss at the long belt, yes. Just making the write-up an agreed action.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Is that rain on someone's microphone, or have we got a crisp packet joining the call?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Headset cable rubbing on my jacket. Teams makes it sound like a bearing failure.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Most convincing bit of audio we've had all morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, six actions agreed. The big board is still blocked, the finished jobs stay finished, and the rattle is only an observation. Nothing else added.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All clear from me. Cheers, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks all. That's us. Bye.
